text: After seventy years, it's one hundred and twenty-eight.
Now take the interest out every year, at the same rate.
zh: 换个做法：每年把利息取走，利率不变。
en: Now take the interest out every year, at the same rate.

text: Seventy years later, you have just over six.
en: Seventy years later, you have just over 6.

text: The last ten years add sixty-four.
That's all the growth before them, plus the dot you started with.
zh: 等于之前所有的增长，再加上最初那个点。
en: That's all the growth before them, plus the dot you started with.

text: Start ten years later, on the same slope,
zh: 同一道坡，晚出发 10 年，
en: Start 10 years later, on the same slope,

text: Seventy-two, divided by your yearly rate,
tells you how many years it takes to double.
en: tells you how many years it takes to double.
